thread:
Priya (release-manager): Quick heads-up — we need a micro version bump to 1.12.1 for a tokenizer edge-case that causes rare truncation on long prompts. Code freeze is in ~2h. Requesting a late-merge exception for PR #5023 (runtime patch + changelog/docs). Can we approve a canary-first merge?
Sarah L: Is this just docs/changelog or touching runtime? want to know QA surface.
Mike C: runtime patch, single-file change in tokenizer.c — small fix to boundary check. I ran local fuzzing and staging CI is green.
Jun Park: I'm +1 for the exception if we do a canary and keep a quick rollback. What's the rollback plan?
Priya (release-manager): Plan: merge to release branch, roll out canary to 5% on dedicated pool, monitor in Grafana for token error spikes, then promote. Rollback is cherry-pick revert + revert-deploy. I'll document steps in the PR.
Mike C: rollback commands added in PR description:
```
# rollback
git checkout release/1.12
git revert -m 1 8f4a2b9
git push origin release/1.12
```
Jun Park: added an automated alert in the canary policy to page eng-oncall if token-error-rate > 0.1% for 5m.
deploy-bot: Release window: 2026-03-17 15:30 UTC — canary OK, full promote at +30m if metrics stable.
Priya (release-manager): tagging approvers: @Sarah L @Mike C — can you drop approvals? I want to merge at T-30 unless objections.
Sarah L: Approved :thumbsup: please include changelog note and highlight the security-esque customer impact.
Mike C: Approved. I'll be on standby for rollback.
Jun Park: I'm good. added one tiny test in tokenizer unit tests, CI green.
Priya (release-manager): Thanks — merging at T-25. Will update this thread after canary.
deploy-bot: Merge confirmed: PR #5023 merged into release/1.12 by priya-rm (1765004550). Canary started.
Priya (release-manager): Canary running — no regressions so far (10m). Will promote at +30m if stable. Thanks team!
